source.prompt: Create a landing page for Okonkwo Beauty Studio at 7A Rye Lane, Peckham, London SE15 4RU. Named staff: Chidinma Okonkwo (founder, NVQ Level 3, trichology diploma), Abena Boateng (senior stylist, wig specialist), Funmi Odebode (beauty therapist). Services with prices: Box Braids £140, Knotless Box Braids £165, Silk Press £65, Gel Manicure £35, Facial £50, etc. Opening hours Mon-Fri 10am-8pm (Wed closed), Sat 9am-6pm. All copy specific to this business and location only.

notes: Specific neighbourhood (Peckham, SE15), named stylists with real qualifications and backstories, detailed GBP price menu, West African specialism, local transport info, concrete booking policies.
